dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Highly visible repeating horizontal contrast lines formed by pale-edged greater and median coverts against dark feather centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale boundaries visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Clear horizontal demarcation separating the uniform tan-brown nape from the dark, pale-fringed mantle feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely consistent scaly appearance across all dorsal plumage caused by high-contrast pale margins on dark feathers.
